row.evidence: Lever's help centre returns only the Aquera article for "scim"; there, SCIM is a protocol option on Aquera's connector ("SCIM is the default value"), which uses Lever API credentials, and Okta's own Lever app is SAML-only.
row.notes: Status changed from gated (June) to none: no first-party SCIM endpoint is documented; SCIM/Okta lifecycle exists only through the third-party Aquera connector (Lever HR-as-a-Master by Aquera, built and maintained by Aquera), which does not change status. June's "LeverTRM for Enterprise" plan and ~$6K-12K/yr and 2-3x estimates have no first-party source and were dropped; the pricing page now shows one Core Platform sold by custom quote plus add-ons. SAML is Enterprise-only on legacy plans and is set up by Lever Support. REST Data API has users list/create/update/deactivate/reactivate and audit events; Rippling and Aquera provision through it.

plans.name: Core Platform
plans.notes: Single quoted platform plus add-ons (Candidate Insights, AI Screening by VONQ, Onboarding). SAML is Enterprise-only on legacy plans; the current plan's SAML terms are not stated.

scim.notes: Help-centre search for "scim" returns only the Aquera article. The SCIM endpoint there is Aquera's connector URL; Aquera calls Lever's REST API (tenant api.lever.co).

limitations.text: No first-party SCIM endpoint; SCIM is offered only through the third-party Aquera connector, which uses Lever API credentials.

user_api.notes: API is part of the single quoted platform; no plan gate is stated.

webhooks_user_events.notes: Webhook events listed are candidate, application, interview and contact events only.

rate_limits.text: Token bucket per API key: 10 requests/second steady state, bursts to 20/second.

okta.notes: Okta's own Lever app ticks SAML only (last updated Jun 9 2016). Provisioning in OIN is the separate "Lever HR-as-a-Master by Aquera" app, built and maintained by Aquera (ticks SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate).

entra.notes: Lever documents Entra SAML via a non-gallery app; no Lever entry in the Microsoft Learn saas-apps index.

google.notes: Lever supports Google sign-in (social login, not SAML); no Google Workspace SAML or provisioning documented.

onelogin.notes: Lever lists OneLogin as a SAML provider; no OneLogin provisioning documented.

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud article covers SAML SSO only.

fallbacks.other_sync: Rippling app (creates and removes Lever accounts via a Lever API key); Aquera HR-as-a-Master/SCIM connector (third party)
fallbacks.notes: Any login with an email on the organisation's domain is auto-granted Interviewer access (not specific to SAML).
